title: Quick pillowy Croatian Vegan meal Dumplings
description: Fresh, pillowy, meal-prep Croatian dish featuring salsa, pickle, vegan-friendly ingredients.

ingredients.name: all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: use a high-protein flour if possible

ingredients.name: sour cream (vegan)
ingredients.notes: use a plant-based sour cream alternative

instructions: Combine flour, warm water, sour cream, and salt in a large mixing bowl. Mix until a smooth dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5-7 minutes, until it becomes elastic and smooth.
Divide the dough into 8-10 equal pieces.
Roll each piece into a ball and then flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Heat a large non-stick skillet over medium heat and add the olive oil.
Cook the dumplings for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown and cooked through.
While the dumplings are cooking, combine chopped pickled cabbage and salsa in a small bowl.
Serve the cooked dumplings with the cabbage-salsa mixture spooned over the top and garnished with chopped parsley.
To freeze, place cooked dumplings on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and freeze until solid. Transfer the frozen dumplings to a freezer-safe bag or container for storage.
